liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Days Between** (2 reviews): The last five to seven minutes of Space leading into Days Between feel sad, profound and beautiful; heard on the Grateful Dead Hour; Days Between stands out especially among the nice gems of the show [11][12]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Played shorter than normal [13]
- **Picasso Moon** (1 review): Band rave it up and the song takes flight, though the ending gets messy, as usual for this number [13]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Reviewer recalls a conga line possibly forming during it; the energy audibly picks up [20]
- **Samson & Delilah** (1 review): Singled out as one of the show's nice highlights, along with Row Jimmy and Picasso Moon [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Electronic Percussion**: rare: 12 archived performances [21]
- **crowd chant**: back after 121 archived shows (552 days) [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-02.132486.nak300.andrewf.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 187 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: A few mic bumps are audible in the second set because the building was shaking [1]
- **gd94-10-02.pmb.pujol.15111.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 185 min; rated 3.62/5 by 8 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds better than they remembered [11]
- **gd1994-10-02.akg460.flaschner.sobel.84028.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 187 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [7]
- **gd1994-10-02.140243.FOB.Schoeps.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 187 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer turned 30 at the show, flew in from Piqua, Ohio, and had a cheap lobster dinner; found it above average [10]
- A friend's birthday; she was upset about missing many songs before the drums segment [9]
- Attendee on the floor felt no energy at the show and found every tune flat [15]
- Reviewer enjoyed the previous night's show more than this one [10]
- Setlist not stellar; several better shows occurred during this final run at the Garden [12]
- First set follows a monster previous show; the band cranks things up from Samson through Truckin' [13]
- Attendee felt this show was a letdown after the unbelievable show the night before [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-02.132486.nak300.andrewf.flac1644**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Casio DA-7 > TDK DC4 DAT. Mics on 7-foot stand, end of floor, center & straight back by the hockey wall. [1]. Also: A patch covers the opening crowd chant track, first 2:30 [1]
- **gd94-10-02.pmb.pujol.15111.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dave Minor; transferred by Marc Pujol; source: Audience: PMB Microphones [5]. Also: Taper used PMB mics from the taper section with a stand and preamp, recorded to DAT, alongside friend Dave Minor [14]
- **gd1994-10-02.akg460.flaschner.sobel.84028.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner and Tom McMinn; transferred by Jason Sobel; source: AKG 460B/ck61 > custom pre-amp > Teac DA-P20 > Sony D7 (@ 48 kHz) [7]. Also: Original DAT was recorded with pre-emphasis, de-emphasized with a Waves Q10 EQ plug-in; dropouts patched with PMB microphone source; Master DAT came from Dave on a 3-hour tape, nearly at its end by the second set's close [7]
- **gd1994-10-02.140243.FOB.Schoeps.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Rich Gastwirt's Master Audience Dat recording: Schoeps CMC4 MK4> Panasonic SV-255> DAT (48k) (FOB); Charlie Miller [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1994-10-02 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1994-10-02-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [22]
